SELECT 'bond' AS business_domain WHERE #{userId} IN (1) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ais_inv_analysis.t_sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN ais_inv_analysis.t_sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.enable = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.role_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10) )
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fund' AS business_domain WHERE #{userId} IN (1, 3) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ais_inv_analysis.t_sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN ais_inv_analysis.t_sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.enable = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.role_id IN (7, 8, 9, 10) )
ORDER BY business_domain
